Data:Towards.numa.json.label: Towards Numa
Data:Towards.numa.json.desc: The season called Numa visits Brancrug once every nine seasons; but Numa is capricious as mist. Exactly when in those nine seasons it will fall - that is very hard to know. But the closer to nine this number comes, the sooner Numa will arrive.

Data:Toxin.glassfinger.json.Label: Glassfinger Toxin
Data:Toxin.glassfinger.json.Desc: 'What is within, without; what is without, within.' A poison sacred to the votaries of the Meniscate.

xexts.scrutiny: Careful… [There are Scholar-level Knock recipes - sometimes Scale - that can be used with a suitable liquid to craft this.]

Data:Trn.order.send.json.label: Post a Completed T.R.N. Order Form
Data:Trn.order.send.json.desc: The Postmistress signs and seals the order, and places it in the place that stamped orders are properly placed. 'Wait three days,' she commands.

Data:Trn.orderform.send.json.label: An Invitation from T.R.N. Limited
Data:Trn.orderform.send.json.startdescription: I've received a short catalogue, neatly printed on paper of creamy smoothness, from T.R.N. Limited. A compliment slip advises me that they have reserved a space for me in their client list.

Data:Trophy.deer.red.json.Label: Red Deer Antlers
Data:Trophy.deer.red.json.Desc: Not quite hair, not quite teeth, but proof that someone killed something.

xexts.scrutiny: BD' is scratched on one antler. Bryan Dewulf was a prolific and successful hunter in his time…

Data:Trophy.yeth.hound.json.Label: Yeth-Hound Horns
Data:Trophy.yeth.hound.json.Desc: In times past the Yeth pursued the impious and impure across the moors of this country. Hendrik Dewulf never liked them.

xexts.scrutiny: Someone has scratched derisively on one horn 'Pray Thou Upon This!'

Data:Trumpeters.lily.json.Label: Trumpeter's Lily
Data:Trumpeters.lily.json.Desc: A glorious efflorescence of sunset orange.

xexts.scrutiny: Traditionally, the flower of the western Library named Crossrow, where the Watchman, the Vagabond, and Sunset Celia are all celebrated.

Data:Twopence.json.label: Twopence
Data:Twopence.json.desc: Or, if you prefer, 'tuppence'. A sort of Janus of pennies.

Data:Typewriter.json.Label: Typewriter
Data:Typewriter.json.Desc: Now they call it unromantic. In fifty years it'll be the most romantic thing in the room.

xexts.scrutiny: The keys are bone, inlaid with ivory.
